notes.title: New Update to Version 1.0.5 Released
notes.notes:
Changes in Version 1.0.5

 The number of stars required to get PowerUps where adjusted to improve user experience.
 Now when you get all hourglasses in every level you'll receive one PowerUp.
 Level 1 in easy mode is really easier now, allowing unexperienced user to win this level.
 Minor bugs in gameplay are fixed. 


Enjoy!

 - Especial thanks to Rxbbit for all the recommendations! -
